functions.name: download-sensor-graph
functions.description: Render a sensor graph with caller-selected dimensions, channels, and styling. Preset periods support PNG and SVG; a custom historic range supports PNG.

sensorId.description: Opaque ID of the sensor to graph.

format.description: Image format; custom historic ranges support only png.

period.description: Preset provider graph period or a caller-specified historic range.

startAt.description: Inclusive requested custom-range start instant with explicit offset; whole-second precision only.

endAt.description: Requested custom-range end instant with explicit offset, after startAt and at most 24 hours later; whole-second precision only.

width.description: Image width in pixels; local maximum 2000.

height.description: Image height in pixels; local maximum 2000.

fontSize.description: Graph base font size, using the provider's font-size convention.

gridColor.description: Color for horizontal and vertical plot grid lines.

plotColor.description: Solid plot-area color; overrides alternating plot colors.

showLegend.description: Whether to display the legend; omitted leaves provider styling unchanged.

clusterNodeId.description: Cluster node UUID without braces; all-zero UUID requests all nodes. Omitted uses the provider default.

averageSeconds.description: Custom-range averaging interval in seconds; 0 requests raw samples. Only applies to custom ranges.

backgroundColor.description: PNG surrounding background color as a six-digit hexadecimal color.

hiddenChannelIds.description: Channel IDs to hide; an empty array hides none.

items.description: Opaque channel ID to hide.

FunctionInput_prtg_classic_downloadsenso.description: Sensor graph selection, image dimensions, channels, and styling.

sensorId.description: ID of the graphed sensor.

mediaType.description: Media type corresponding to the requested image format.

contentBase64.description: Base64 encoding of the exact returned image bytes; no authentication material is included.

FunctionOutput_prtg_classic_downloadsens.description: Rendered sensor graph bytes encoded as base64, with the sensor ID and image media type.

tags.instructions: Use for a rendered image, not sample values; use `list-historic-sensor-readings` for values. Get channel IDs from `get-sensor-graph-legend`. Preset periods support PNG or SVG; custom ranges require PNG and are limited to 24 hours per call. Historic requests share PRTG's five-per-minute limit. Returned content is base64 image bytes, not a credential-bearing URL.

items.description: Metadata for one generated PDF stored for the selected report.
One page of generated report-file metadata.

FunctionOutput_prtg_classic_liststoredre.description: Stored PDF metadata and an optional continuation for the same report and limit.

tags.instructions: Obtain reportId from `list-reports`. This lists generated-file metadata; it does not generate or download a PDF. Continue with nextCursor as cursor using the same report and limit. Default limit 100, maximum 500.

state.description: Service state as reported by the device; omitted outside services or if unavailable.

caption.description: Hardware caption; omitted outside hardware or if unavailable.

version.description: Installed software version; omitted outside software or if unavailable.

className.description: Hardware class; omitted outside hardware or if unavailable.

createdAt.description: Process creation instant in UTC, preserving source precision; omitted if unavailable.

tags.instructions: Get the device ID from `list-devices`. Use `get-system-information-scan` to check data freshness and scan success; this tool never refreshes data. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same device, category, and limit for another page. The default limit is 100 and the maximum is 500.

functions.name: list-ticket-edits

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same ticket and limit; omit initially.

ticketId.description: Opaque ticket ID whose history is requested.

FunctionInput_prtg_classic_listticketedi.description: Select a ticket and one bounded page of its edit history.

text.description: Text added by this edit, decoded to ordinary Unicode text; empty additions remain empty.

actions.description: Provider description of ticket edit actions; not an invented action taxonomy.

message.description: History-entry message as plain text, distinct from added text.

editedAt.description: Edit instant in UTC, preserving source precision; omitted if unavailable.

ticketId.description: Ticket to which this edit belongs.

modifiedBy.description: Provider's editor value where supplied; kept distinct from user.

items.description: One provider history entry, without an invented edit identifier.
One page of history edits; no invented edit identifiers.

FunctionOutput_prtg_classic_listticketed.description: Ticket edits in provider order and an optional continuation, without a snapshot guarantee.

tags.instructions: Obtain ticketId from `list-tickets` or a known ticket. Use `get-ticket` for its current subject, assignee, and state. Pass nextCursor as cursor with the same ticket and limit for another page. Default limit 100, maximum 500.

functions.name: list-tickets
functions.description: List one page of accessible tickets, optionally scoped to a monitoring object and filtered by one ticket criterion.

limit.description: Maximum tickets per page; defaults to 100.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same selection and limit; omit initially.

status.description: Optional ticket-state filter, exclusive with the other ticket filters.

recency.description: Optional provider-relative age window, exclusive with other filters; interpreted by PRTG.

assignee.description: Optional PRTG user or group filter value, exclusive with other filters; provider matching representation is validated during implementation.

objectId.description: Optional monitoring-object ID; includes related tickets for it and its children.

ticketType.description: Optional ticket type, exclusive with other ticket filters.

FunctionInput_prtg_classic_listtickets.description: Select one page of accessible tickets with at most one ticket filter.

id.description: Opaque ticket ID, sourced from the ticket-specific parentid field.

status.description: Ticket state, normally open, resolved, or closed; unknown values retained.

assignee.description: Assigned user or group as provider text; omitted if unavailable.

updatedAt.description: Last ticket modification instant normalized to UTC without precision loss; omitted if unavailable.

ticketType.description: Ticket type, normally user, notification, or todo.

relatedObjectId.description: Opaque ID of the related monitoring object; omitted if unavailable.

relatedObjectName.description: Name of the related monitoring object.

items.description: A ticket and its related monitoring object.
One page of ticket records.

FunctionOutput_prtg_classic_listtickets.description: One page of accessible tickets and an optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use to discover ticket IDs. Use `get-ticket` for a known ticket and `list-ticket-edits` for history. PRTG does not support multiple ticket filters together; choose at most one status, assignee, type, or recency filter. Continue with nextCursor as cursor and unchanged selection/limit. Default limit 100, maximum 500.

functions.name: list-toplists
functions.description: List one page of available Toplist descriptors, optionally scoped to a sensor.

limit.description: Maximum descriptors per page; defaults to 100.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same sensor selection and limit; omit initially.

sensorId.description: Optional sensor ID limiting Toplists; omit for the provider's accessible Toplist collection.

FunctionInput_prtg_classic_listtoplists.description: Select a page of accessible Toplist descriptors, optionally for one sensor.

id.description: Provider Toplist object identifier from objid, if supplied; its exact scope must be validated.

sensorName.description: Associated sensor name where supplied; not a sensor ID.

items.description: An available Toplist descriptor, without ranked traffic rows.
One page of Toplist descriptors.

FunctionOutput_prtg_classic_listtoplists.description: One page of Toplist descriptors and a continuation when more descriptors exist.

tags.instructions: Use to discover Toplist descriptors for traffic-monitoring diagnostics. A sensor ID can come from `list-sensors`. This tool lists descriptors, not arbitrary Toplist time-series exports. Continue with nextCursor as cursor and unchanged sensor/limit. Default limit 100, maximum 500.

functions.name: pause-object
functions.description: Pause a supported object indefinitely or for a chosen number of minutes, with an optional displayed message.

message.description: Optional displayed pause message as ordinary Unicode text; omitted sends no message and empty sends an explicit empty message.

objectId.description: Opaque ID of the supported object to pause.

durationMinutes.description: Pause duration in whole minutes; omitted pauses indefinitely.

FunctionInput_prtg_classic_pauseobject.description: Object to pause, with an optional duration and displayed message.

objectId.description: ID of the paused object.

completed.description: PRTG confirmed completion of the pause call; this is not a newly measured monitoring status.

FunctionOutput_prtg_classic_pauseobject.description: Acknowledgment that PRTG completed the pause request for the specified object.

tags.instructions: Use to pause rather than delete an object. Obtain its ID in PRTG and inspect it with `get-object-status` when applicable. Omit durationMinutes for an indefinite pause; use `resume-object` to resume early. Indefinite pause supports probes, groups, devices, sensors, notifications, and user accounts; pausing a user account or notification can affect access or notification behavior.

functions.name: refresh-system-information
functions.description: Request refreshed device system information. Although a category is selected, PRTG rescans all system-information tables.

category.description: Category requested through PRTG; the action still rescans all system-information tables.

deviceId.description: Opaque ID of the device to refresh.

FunctionInput_prtg_classic_refreshsystem.description: Device and category for a refresh of all device system-information tables.

category.description: Category supplied for the refresh request.

requested.description: PRTG accepted the request, not a guarantee that rescanning has completed.

FunctionOutput_prtg_classic_refreshsyste.description: Acknowledgement of the refresh request, without waiting for rescanning to complete.

tags.instructions: Use only when fresh device inventory is necessary: a refresh rescans every system-information table. Obtain the device ID from `list-devices`. This tool acknowledges the request without waiting for completion. Check `get-system-information-scan` afterward, then use `list-system-information-entries`.

functions.name: rename-object
functions.description: Replace the display name of a supported object, including administrative users and user groups.

name.description: Replacement display name as ordinary Unicode text; empty or null names are not accepted.

objectId.description: Opaque ID of the supported object to rename.

FunctionInput_prtg_classic_renameobject.description: The supported PRTG object to rename and its replacement display name.

objectId.description: ID of the renamed object; identity is unchanged.

completed.description: PRTG confirmed successful completion of the rename call.

FunctionOutput_prtg_classic_renameobject.description: Confirmation that PRTG completed the rename without changing the object identity.

tags.instructions: Use for renaming a group, device, sensor, map, report, library, notification template, schedule, user, or user group. Obtain and verify its ID in PRTG. Probe renaming is not supported by this action. Administrative objects may require administrator access.

functions.name: reorder-object
functions.description: Move an object's display position up, down, to the top, or to the bottom in the sensor tree.

objectId.description: ID of the reordered object.

completed.description: PRTG confirmed completion of the reorder call; no absolute index is inferred.

FunctionOutput_prtg_classic_reorderobjec.description: Confirmation that PRTG completed the reorder call.

tags.instructions: Use to change ordering, not to move an object to another parent. Obtain its ID in PRTG. Each up or down invocation moves again; do not replay an uncertain result without checking the tree. This does not copy or delete the object.

functions.name: resume-object
functions.description: Resume a supported paused object, including a newly copied monitoring object.

objectId.description: Opaque ID of the paused probe, group, device, sensor, notification, or user account to resume.

completed.description: The resume API call succeeded; not proof of an Up monitoring result.

FunctionOutput_prtg_classic_resumeobject.description: Confirmation that PRTG completed the resume API call.

tags.instructions: Use after editing a paused copy or ending a manual pause. Obtain the ID from `copy-object` or PRTG. Use `pause-object` for the opposite action. Resuming does not prove the monitored system is Up, nor remove unrelated parent, dependency, or schedule conditions.

functions.name: scan-sensor
functions.description: Request an immediate measurement of a sensor without waiting for scan completion.

sensorId.description: Opaque ID of the sensor to scan.

FunctionOutput_prtg_classic_scansensor.description: Acknowledgement of the scan request, not measurement completion.

tags.instructions: Use when a known sensor needs a fresh measurement. Obtain its ID from `list-sensors`. A successful result means PRTG accepted the scan request, not that a new measurement is available. Read `get-sensor` or `list-sensor-channels` afterward. Repeating the call can request another scan.

functions.name: simulate-sensor-error
functions.description: Simulate an error on a sensor currently Up, Warning, Unusual, or Unknown for monitoring tests.

FunctionOutput_prtg_classic_simulatesens.description: Acknowledgement of the sensor error simulation request.

tags.instructions: Use only for a deliberate monitoring-error test. Get the sensor ID and current status from `list-sensors`. The sensor must be Up, Warning, Unusual, or Unknown. This changes monitoring state and may activate downstream notifications. The duration and automatic recovery are not guaranteed; inspect the sensor afterward.

functions.name: start-auto-discovery

PRTG changes a No auto-discovery setting to Standard auto-discovery when this action is used. Check progress and discovered objects in PRTG afterward.

functions.name: update-channel-settings
functions.description: Partially modify a sensor channel's name, limit thresholds, limit activation, and limit messages.

sensorId.description: Opaque ID of the sensor containing the channel.

name.description: Replacement channel name as Unicode text.

warningMessage.description: Replacement warning-limit message; empty clears the message.

upperErrorLimit.description: Upper error threshold in the channel's configured numeric unit, or null to clear.

lowerWarningLimit.description: Lower warning threshold in the channel's configured numeric unit, or null to clear.

upperWarningLimit.description: Upper warning threshold in the channel's configured numeric unit, or null to clear.

settings.description: Partial channel settings; omitted fields remain unsubmitted. Null is accepted only to clear a threshold.

channelId.description: Opaque channel ID scoped to that sensor.

sensorId.description: ID of the sensor containing the edited channel.

FunctionOutput_prtg_classic_updatechanne.description: Acknowledgment that all requested channel setting writes succeeded.

tags.instructions: Get sensor/channel IDs from PRTG and `get-sensor-graph-legend`; inspect current values with `get-channel-settings`. Supply only settings to change. Threshold null clears that threshold; omitted fields are untouched. Limits are written before activation. Several writes may be needed and are not atomic; inspect settings after any error before retrying.

Schedules, Dependencies, and Maintenance Window inheritance are not supported by this action. Changing access-rights or credential inheritance can have broad effects and may require administrator authority.

functions.description: Set an object's map-marker coordinates and optionally its displayed location name, without invoking a potentially long-running location-name lookup.

FunctionInput_prtg_classic_updateobjectl.description: Object and explicit map coordinates, with an optional displayed location name.

completed.description: PRTG confirmed completion of the explicit location update.

Coordinates are required so the call does not invoke PRTG's location-name-only lookup, which can take three minutes. Omit locationName to leave the name unsubmitted. This overwrites the marker position; use PRTG's UI for name-only geocoding.

completed.description: PRTG confirmed completion of the priority update.

functions.name: update-object-property

completed.description: The property write completed successfully; not a read-back of provider-normalized data.

Use `update-object-inheritance` for inheritance and `update-channel-settings` for channels. Get the current value with `get-object-property`. functions.name: update-toplist-property
functions.description: Replace one named string or numeric property of a sensor's Toplist.

sensorId.description: Opaque ID of the sensor containing the Toplist.

toplistId.description: Opaque ID of the Toplist scoped to that sensor.

propertyName.description: Internal Toplist property name from the installation's settings.

FunctionInput_prtg_classic_updatetoplist.description: One named property to replace on a sensor Toplist.

sensorId.description: ID of the containing sensor.
